proof_scope: deterministic gates over this skill's own contract file and the load-bearing quotes it anchors in composed skills; no live browser transport is exercised

claims.proves: the seven-rule contract is present and intact, its sanity gate fails closed when a rule is removed, and the cross-skill quotes it depends on (the ask read-whole-file instruction, the ChatGPT acceptance signature) still exist where this skill says they do
claims.does_not_prove: that an agent following the rules delivers correctly on a live browser lane; that requires the ask/surf live fixtures this skill's rules were derived from

cases.name: dropping-a-rule-fails-the-gate-closed
command: cd .. && if python3 scripts/verify_contract.py check --mutate-drop-rule 3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo GATE_DID_NOT_FAIL; exit 1; else echo GATE_FAILED_CLOSED; fi

cases.name: a-random-rule-drop-is-caught-each-run
command: cd .. && N=$((RANDOM % 7 + 1)); if python3 scripts/verify_contract.py check --mutate-drop-rule $N >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo GATE_MISSED_RULE_$N; exit 1; else echo GATE_CAUGHT_RULE_$N; fi

cases.name: read-gate-hook-blocks-unread-delivery-and-passes-covered
command: cd .. && A=fixtures/.read-attestation.json; [ -f $A ] && mv $A $A.hold; printf '{"tool_input":{"command":"./run.sh webgpt.submit --input x --tab-id 1"},"transcript_path":"/nonexistent"}' | python3 scripts/enforce_read_gate.py >/dev/null 2>&1; U=$?; printf '{"tool_input":{"command":"ls -la"},"transcript_path":"/nonexistent"}' | python3 scripts/enforce_read_gate.py >/dev/null 2>&1; N=$?; [ -f $A.hold ] && mv $A.hold $A; if [ "$U" -eq 2 ] && [ "$N" -eq 0 ]; then echo HOOK_BLOCKS_UNREAD_AND_IGNORES_NONDELIVERY; else echo HOOK_CONTRACT_BROKEN U=$U N=$N; exit 1; fi

cases.name: attestation-gates-and-voids-on-drift
command: cd .. && python3 scripts/verify_contract.py attest >/dev/null && printf '{"tool_input":{"command":"./run.sh webgpt.submit --input x --tab-id 1"},"transcript_path":"/nonexistent"}' | python3 scripts/enforce_read_gate.py >/dev/null 2>&1; A=$?; python3 -c "import json;p='fixtures/.read-attestation.json';d=json.load(open(p));d['contracts'][0]['sha256']='0'*64;json.dump(d,open(p,'w'))"; printf '{"tool_input":{"command":"./run.sh webgpt.submit --input x --tab-id 1"},"transcript_path":"/nonexistent"}' | python3 scripts/enforce_read_gate.py >/dev/null 2>&1; S=$?; python3 scripts/verify_contract.py attest >/dev/null; if [ "$A" -eq 0 ] && [ "$S" -eq 2 ]; then echo ATTESTATION_GATES_AND_VOIDS; else echo ATTESTATION_CONTRACT_BROKEN A=$A S=$S; exit 1; fi

cases.name: regression-five-failed-submits-rejected
command: cd .. && python3 scripts/assess.py --input fixtures/incidents/five-failed-submits.json --require-escalation-ladder 2>&1; test $? -eq 2 && python3 scripts/assess.py --input fixtures/incidents/five-failed-submits.json --require-escalation-ladder 2>&1 | grep -q UNCHANGED_RETRY_AFTER_FAILURE && echo REGRESSION_GUARD_FIRES

cases.name: regression-false-delivery-claim-rejected
command: cd .. && OUT=$(python3 scripts/assess.py --input fixtures/incidents/false-delivery-reports.json --require-destination-receipts 2>&1); test $? -eq 2 && echo "$OUT" | grep -q SELF_STATUS_IS_NOT_DESTINATION_RECEIPT && echo "$OUT" | grep -q SUBMITTED_NO_RESPONSE_NOT_PROMOTED_TO_RESPONSE && echo FALSE_CLAIM_GUARD_FIRES

cases.name: effect-family-matrix-governs-and-ignores-near-matches
command: cd .. && A=fixtures/.read-attestation.json; [ -f $A ] && mv $A $A.hold; R=0; for CMD in 'git push origin main' 'run.sh herdr send memory hi'; do printf '{"tool_input":{"command":"%s"},"transcript_path":"/nonexistent"}' "$CMD" | python3 scripts/enforce_read_gate.py >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -ne 2 ] && R=1; done; for CMD in 'echo git pushing is fun' 'grep webgpt.submit file.md' 'git pushup'; do printf '{"tool_input":{"command":"%s"},"transcript_path":"/nonexistent"}' "$CMD" | python3 scripts/enforce_read_gate.py >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -ne 0 ] && R=1; done; [ -f $A.hold ] && mv $A.hold $A; [ $R -eq 0 ] && echo EFFECT_MATRIX_GOVERNED || { echo EFFECT_MATRIX_BROKEN; exit 1; }

capability_claims.description: Covered external-effect commands are blocked until every transitive contract has a complete, current, digest-bound read attestation.
The hook governs browser-submit, pane-send, and push families and passes harmless near-matches.
A delivery/response claim is accepted only with a fresh destination receipt whose target and proof_status support that exact claim.

exemptions.justification: The live browser round that binds a final claim to a destination receipt (webgpt-proposed case delivery-proof.live.browser-destination-proof) is designed but not yet implemented; the deterministic incident guards cover the failure mode observed 2026-08-18.

capability_claims.description: Failed operations cannot be repeated unchanged, skip rungs, reuse stale artifacts, or leave unowned lock-holding children.

failure_modes: a partial or stale contract read is accepted as complete
a governed effect bypasses the hook through an unrecognized command form
self-status or a wrong-target receipt is accepted as destination proof
a final report promotes submitted_no_response_proof into a response claim
an unchanged failed operation is retried instead of escalated
pattern kills match the invoking shell
stale shared artifacts replay a previous attempt
